version_scope: current SNaQ.jl; historical PhyloNetworks API tracked separately

capabilities.description: Infers a level-1 phylogenetic network from quartet concordance factors and a starting tree.

output_contracts.format: extended Newick or Julia network representation

limitations: Current SNaQ.jl documentation must not be treated as identical to the historical PhyloNetworks API.
Exact concordance-factor schemas and rooting requirements require version-specific review.
This initial extraction does not yet cover every optimization, topology and analysis option.
Human review is required before promotion.
